caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular frame with a black outline and contains German calligraphy text in black ink. At the top within the border appears the inscription "1. B. Samuel 16. V. 7." Below this, stylized black script forms the main text, interspersed in the upper middle area with two illustrated human eyes with brown irises and pinkish eyelids, aligned horizontally. Below the eyes, the text continues and then is interrupted by an image of a red anatomical heart with the word "an." written in black inside the heart; the heart has a flame-like design at the top. The heart is surrounded below and to the left and right by curving sprigs of green leaves and blue and red berries, encircled by a blue ribbon with visible bows at the bottom. Ornamental blue scrollwork appears on both the left and right sides of the main text, extending vertically. At the bottom inside the border, the final portion of the text is written in a similar calligraphic style. The drawing is on a beige background, and the composition is vertically oriented. In the bottom right corner outside the border, the name "JERRY GUINTA" is printed in small uppercase letters.
title: Pa. German Illustrated Fractur
